English: Prayer Stand
A simple wooden stand for daily prayers, adorned with a few icons and offerings, fostering unity among the clan.
Stone Marker
A sacred stone stela inscribed with prayers, marking the clans devotion and serving as a gathering point.
Walled Shrine
A modest shrine of clay and stone walls, offering sanctuary for rituals and binding the clan together in worship.
Pillar Pavilion
A sheltered pavilion supported by carved wooden pillars, hosting clan ceremonies and enhancing spiritual unity.
Chanting Room
A dedicated chamber for devotional chants and recitations, reverberating with sacred mantras and fostering harmony.
Altar Hall
A grand hall housing a communal altar, where offerings and large festivals unite the clan in faith.
Priests Chamber
Residential quarters for priests and spiritual guides, ensuring constant religious counsel to the khan and clan.
Diviners Room
A sanctified space for diviners to read omens and guide the horde, strengthening spiritual resolve and internal harmony.
Sanctified Sanctuary
A magnificent sanctuary, sanctified by holy rites, drawing pilgrims and binding the clan through shared faith and ritual.
Grand Mandir
A sprawling, awe-inspiring mandir, center of spiritual life for the horde, radiating unity, piety, and prestige throughout the lands.
